---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible interface problem using nonconfidential inputs
---

Describe the problem and the behavior you expected.

Include the interface version/commit, Python version, operating system, and
relevant NAMD/TURBOMOLE versions. Provide a minimal synthetic reproduction and a
short, reviewed error excerpt.

Do not attach research structures, topology, raw calculation logs, trajectories,
orbital files, credentials, or personal paths. For sensitive issues, follow
SECURITY.md instead of posting details publicly.
